system.description:
Size Medium • Speed 30ft • Darkvision 60ft • +2 Wis / +1 Cha, −1 Str

Traits

  • Resistance 5 to necrotic & radiant. 1/long rest: bright light 10ft radius (illumination only). 1/long rest: Lay on Hands heal = character level.
  • Advantage on saves vs frightened.
  • Choose one Wisdom or Charisma skill at creation; you have Advantage on checks with it. This is not a Proficiency tier and does not take an NWP slot.
